title: A pile of answers
labels: How can we show it clearly?
description: A pile of 6 paper slips with fruit drawings on the left and a large question mark on the right, asking how to show the class answers clearly.

title: Ask everyone, write a list
description: Five classmate circles with an arrow to a list sheet with five lines, each holding one answer dot.

title: Group, count, compare
description: A mixed row of 12 coloured circles, an arrow, and the same circles sorted into 3 rows of 4, one row per colour.

title: A bundle of five
description: One tally bundle of 4 vertical strokes with a fifth stroke drawn across them.

title: Reading a frequency table
description: A frequency table with columns Juice and Frequency and rows Mango 8, Lemon 5 and Guava 4, with the mango row highlighted.

title: Smallest first, largest last
description: A row of 7 cards 3, 3, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6 in ascending order, the first card teal as smallest and the last card amber as largest.

title: List and table
description: Ten ordered shoe-size cards in two rows of 5 on the left and a 4-row frequency table of the same data on the right.

title: Longest row wins
labels: Longest row is the most students
description: Two rows of smileys: 4 amber for private car and 11 teal for school bus, with the key 1 smiley = 1 student.

title: Reading a triangle key
description: A key line and two rows of triangles: 5 triangles make 50 children, and 2 triangles plus a half make 25.

title: Too many smileys
description: A grid of 35 smileys for one class, with a line saying all 8 classes need 215 smileys.

title: Why 33 cannot be drawn
description: A row of 3 smileys for 30 students, 3 leftover dots, and a half smiley outline showing half is 5.

title: Reading one bar
description: One teal bar for Class 2 that is 5 units tall, with a dotted line across to 5 on the side numbers.

title: Read the scale first
description: A bar of 12 units with the first unit marked 1 unit = 100 vehicles, and the line 12 × 100 = 1200 vehicles.

title: Growth between two bars
description: Two bars, 36 crores in 1951 and 102 crores in 2001, with the top 66 crores highlighted and 102 − 36 = 66.

title: Axes, scale and bars
description: A simple bar graph frame: horizontal and vertical lines, 6 equal ticks, and 3 equal-width bars of heights 3, 5 and 2 steps.

title: Choosing a scale of 10
description: A scale from 0 to 10 units with a teal bar 10 units tall for 100 runs and an amber bar 5 units tall for 50 runs.

title: Rent as 15 units
description: A teal bar of 15 equal blocks for house rent ₹3000 and an amber bar of 4 equal blocks for education ₹800, each block worth ₹200.

title: Three ways to show data
description: Three equal panels showing Apples 4 and Bananas 2 as a table, a pictograph of 4 and 2 circles, and a bar graph with bars 4 and 2 units tall.

title: Height gap of two peaks
description: Two bars to scale: Everest 8848 m and Koscuiszko 2228 m, with the extra part of the Everest bar highlighted as the 6620 m gap.

title: Only height tells
description: Two equal-width bars with heights 4 and 2 units, a grey bracket marking the equal widths and a purple arrow marking the height.

title: Is twice as tall true
description: Elbrus 5642 m and Everest 8848 m bars to scale, with a dotted line at 11284 m, twice Elbrus, sitting above the Everest top.
